description: List the account's task runs, newest first — delegated jobs and scheduled tasks alike. Filter by status, task, or chat.

chat_id.description: Only the runs of this chat (aichat_...): its first run and every send_message after it. A run id works too.

ending_before.description: Return the page before this id — the first id from the previous page.

starting_after.description: Return the page after this id — the last id from the previous page.

name: list_runs

outputSchema.description: A page of task runs, newest first.

items.description: A task run — one delegated job and what is known about its state.
A file the work produced. Exchange its id for a download link with get_file_download_url.

cancel_requested_at.description: Set once a stop was requested; the run stays running until it reaches its next step, then settles as cancelled.

json.description: The reply parsed as JSON and validated against response_format. Present only when one was given.

json_error.description: Why the reply did not parse or validate against response_format.

wait_timed_out.description: The wait ended first. The work is still running: follow it with the tool next_step names.
